manifest_published_signature.name: manifest_published_signature
manifest_published_signature.value: "install_manifests"."status" <> 'published' OR ("install_manifests"."signature" IS NOT NULL AND length("install_manifests"."signature") > 0 AND "install_manifests"."checksum" IS NOT NULL)

media_dimensions.name: media_dimensions
media_dimensions.value: ("media"."width" IS NULL OR "media"."width" > 0) AND ("media"."height" IS NULL OR "media"."height" > 0)

report_resolution.name: report_resolution
report_resolution.value: "reports"."status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'dismissed') OR ("reports"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
